title: Interoception
summary: The body's internal signalling system — the sense of the physiological condition of the entire body. Interoception provides the raw data from which the nervous system constructs feelings, drives, and the sense of self.

content.title: Core Concept
content.content: Interoception, as mapped by A. D. Craig, is the sense of the physiological condition of the body — heart rate, breath, gut, temperature, pain, and other internal signals. These signals travel through small-diameter afferent nerves to the posterior insula, where they are integrated into a 'global emotional moment.' Craig demonstrated that interoception is not just visceral sensation — it is the foundation of subjective feeling, emotional awareness, and the embodied sense of self.

content.title: How TEG-Blue Integrates This
content.content: TEG-Blue positions interoception as the input channel for neuroception — the raw data the nervous system evaluates when determining safety or threat. The body's internal signals are the first data point in the compass movement sequence: Perception (including interoception) → Neuroception → Emotion → Autonomic Response → Mode Activation. Interoceptive accuracy correlates with emotional awareness — the better the system reads its own signals, the more accurately it can orient.
